notes.title: Version 43 is now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33776553/2e97af4247362258a9e62a3965ac31307c5f8618.png[/img]

Hi folks,
We believe that all of our multiplayer issues will end with this.

Here is the list of updates:
[list]
[*]Change: XBOX Controller mapping.
[*]Fix: "Show animals" button staying on the screen after we closed the map by Escape.
[*]Fix: Wrong collision values buggy driving Patapat.
[*]New: Rebind for movement controls (W,A,S,D). With this, you will able to rebind all of the inputs of the game.
[*]Fix: Chat is not working.
[*]Fix: Stupidly, vehicles not syncing their positions.
[*]Fix: Broken multiplayer when the players change their zones.
[*]New: Now the NPCs can drop an item with random ammos as loot. At the higher difficulties you can get good weapons with more than 1000 ammos from npcs' loot.
[/list]

New contents
[list]
[*]Radio bomb - With this bomb, you will able to clear the area and open the hatches quickly. But It will be a rare item to drop. Also, you will able to train this item as skill.
[*]Powerful Invasion Robots. When you have opened a hatch door, there will be a chance to see a robot invasion will be started at the hatch door. Those robots will give you an insane experience points and loot.
[b]Chance is %10 to % 26 by the game difficulty.[/b]
[/list]

[i]Don't forget to try Radiobomb! But stay away from the target.. Or you gonna explode too.[/i]

notes.title: Version 42 is now available.
notes.content:

Hi folks,
Version 42 is now available.

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]

[*]Change: Improved skills screen.
[*]Fix: Stuck while fetching leaderboards.
[*]Fix: Tooltip values incorrect positioning.
[*]Change: Rank ups will give you 5 skill points now. (No worry for current players.)
[*]Change: Increased enemy count.
[*]Change: More healthly creatures at higher difficulties.
[*]Change: Maximum skill level is now 50.
[/list]

You can report the bugs in-game or on this thread.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/914290/discussions/0/3441214221465397576/

notes.title: Version 41 is now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33776553/1726ce8c1436669217f0aa91e7d359dcea37b3cd.png[/img]

First of all, most of things have been changed with your suggestions & bug reports so we should expect some new bugs :)
We ask you report the bugs in-game or here in discussions.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/914290/discussions/0/1742229167197110179/ 

[list]
[*][b]Technical Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Dynamic Zone Masters[/b]
[code]
Normally, the master of the lobby controls the NPC AI and NPC Spawns. The problem is if there are sixteen players in the lobby and all of them are at different zones, then a lot of NPC will be spawned and those will be controlled by the master of the lobby.
Eventually, 400+ NPCs can be alive so It will definitely impact the performance.

[b]The new design[/b]
[list]
[*]Every zone will have a master. The master will spawn the NPCs and control their AIs. If the master leave the zone, one of the other players in the zone will be the master.
[*]Distant NPCs will be cached on the memory and won't be spawned until the players get close to it. The point is that when the other players are in a battle in a zone, the distant players won't be simulate the war. So it won't impact the performance anymore.
[/code]

[*]Fix: In the first 5-10 minutes after the join the game, you may face some struggles and fatal fps drops for one second.
[*]Fix: (UI) Enemy & damage indicator impacts the performance.
[/list]
*[i]NPC means all the living things,including enemies[/i]

[*][b]Gameplay improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Change: Increased health of Delivery trucks. Also eight players will able to get in the truck together. The old seat was 2.
[*]Fix: Annoying auto vehicle recovery system. 
[*]Fix: Wrong collision values for some vehicles and palm trees.
[*]New: Bullet trails on sky.
[*]New: Able to respawn dead players.
[*]New: Camera share when explosion.
[*]New: Higher enemy count on higher difficulties, more crowded actions.
[*]Change: Vehicles get damage less.
[*]New: Light your flashlight to attract enemies.
[*]Change: Remastered UI design & graphics.
[*]Change: New weapon skill system. You won't increase your skills with money anymore. Now at every rank you have reached, you will get a skill point that can be used on the development of any weapon skills.
[*]Fix: Wrong calculation of delivery truck rewards.
[*]Change: More quicker way to sell/drop items.
[*]New: You will able to increase your maximum health with your skill points.
[*]New: Daily login rewards.
[*]Fix: Cannot open the pause menu when died.
[*]Removed: Vehicle seat change by F buttons.
[*]New: Playable without an internet connection. (Leaderboards, achievements will not work)
[*]Fix: If you leave the game while in an hatch, you will be throwed to the hatch door if you join a game again.
[*]New: VAC is now optional. You can turn it off before creating a game.
[*]Fix: Sound bug at instant camera transitions.
[*]New: Adjustable gamepad axis dead point.
[*]Change: Increased CargoPlane spawn frequency.
[*]Change: CargoPlanes drops local loot now. Every player will get different loots.
[*]Change: Reward boxes drop Quarantine key with a high rate.
[*]Change: Daily login rewards may drop Quarantine key.
[*]Fix: NPCs cannot drop Quarantine keys.
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Important notice for current players[/b]
[code]
With this update,
[list]
[*]Your inventory items will be wiped.
[*]Your weapon skills will be wiped.
[*]You will get skill points by your rank. Etc. if your rank is 50, you will get 50 skill points.[/list]
[/code]

notes.title: Version 39 is now available.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33776553/170005221e3b6eeb326093bbae6aec0b98fc9c68.png[/img]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Delivery trucks are buggy on multiplayer sessions for non-host players.
[*]Fixed: Typing on chat is not lock the input.
[*]Fixed: ATV crash sounds can be heared from anyone.
[*]Fixed: Huge FPS drop when a lot of items dropped on the ground.
[*]Fixed: Huge FPS drop when a lot of ragdolled NPCs.
[*]Fixed: Footsteps sound when walking backward and strafing.
[*]Fixed: Sky objects (Cargo Plane, Zeppelin and Jet) will be removed in 30 seconds after spawned.
[*]Fixed: "Enter the Quarantine" achievement cannot be achieved.
[*]Fixed: Vehicle Input is not locked at the pause menu while playing the game with a gamepad. 
[/list]

[b]News[/b]
[list]
[*]Direction indicator on UI when an enemy is attacking you.
[*]Multiple damage indicator on UI.
[*]A new playable character: Hunter.
[*]Now you can change your crosshair color and image at Options.
[*]Inverted mouse (Y) aim option.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Rewards of the hunting missions are increased.
[*]Exp of poisonus chicken is increased to 1000.
[*]Size of the game is decreased by 800mb.
[*]Ram usage is decreased by 800mb.
[*]Decreased enemy count of difficulties.
[/list]

Please report the bugs in Version 39 as comment here or report in-game. 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/914290/discussions/0/3020122487789721861/

notes.title: Version 38 is now available.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33776553/7288abc58bf3bce7cb9fc26ef14c1ca2ead58427.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Full Controller Support[/b]
Now you can move the virtual pointer with your gamepad and you can play the game without using mouse and keyboard.
Also you can rebind the keys of your gamepad at the key binding menu.

[i]Warning: Gamepad settings won't come with a full preset, you need to bind your gamepad buttons as you like.
Warning: XInput is not supported. Switch your gamepad to DInput mode if you have an XInput controller.[/i]

[*] [b]Fixes[/b] [list]
[*] 2D sounds of Magnum & Flame Thrower are now 3D.
[*] Sound of announcer's flag is decreased.
[*] Language selection is not remembered at next start.
[*] Inventory open close sound was always playing even if the 'settings->sound volume' is zero.
[*] Vehicle start sound was always playing even if the 'settings->sound volume' is zero.
[*] Most of animals are not spawning at their spawn locations.
[*] Some players disconnected in a minute after connected a public lobby.
[*] Seat Copter & Sea Boat may go to under the terrain sometimes.
[*] Input is not locked when typing on the bug reporting screen. (Bug on bug reporting screen :))
[*] 'First Attempt' achievement is not achieving.
[/list]
[*] [b]Changes[/b][list]
[*] Experience points of poisonus chicken is now decreased to 100 (from 1000)
[*] Remade keybinding screen. All keys added for input customization, also for gamepads.
[*] Rewards of truck delivery missions are generously increased.
[*] Turned down vehicles will be rescued by automatically.
[*] More crowded villages.
[*] We have implemented an auto save recovery system, now you won't lose your save file even if it's broken.
[/list]
[/list][*] [b]Performance[/b][list]
[*] Fixed struggling.
[*] Increased framerate.
[/list]
[*] [b]New content[/b][list]
[*] Vehicle -> Galaxy - 2 seats - 5000 health - unlocked at Rank 54.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33776553/81254fee06aa813e631d54187c18d62c988c70e6.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33776553/743eed4890287d28f69aa38a11e07262c6beec8f.png[/img][/url]
[/list]
[/list]

Please report the bugs ingame or comment on this post->
https://steamcommunity.com/app/914290/discussions/0/3020122487775108229/
